one_line: Visual discovery platform whose API v5 lets developers build apps for pins, boards, ads, and shopping.
auth_notes: OAuth2 with scopes (boards:read, pins:read, ads:read, etc.). Requires a Pinterest developer account and registering an app; then submitting the app for review to access most scopes.
self_serve_notes: Free self-serve: create a developer account, register a business app, get client ID/secret, and generate test tokens. App review required before production access to most API features.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Boards, pins, media, users, ad accounts/campaigns/ad groups/ads, audiences, conversions, shopping (products), analytics & reporting; ~60+ endpoints
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for some integration events (e.g., lead ads / conversion).

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP; community MCP servers for Pinterest exist.

evidence.note: Fetched text (2.6KB) covers developer platform overview, app connection, review process, API v5

agent_notes: App review is the main delay; test tokens and sandbox speed up initial development.
